items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So I went downtown that night and got a job immediately, starting the next night, with Thelonious Monk, playing in a mission for Dizzy's big band.

ctx.x: So what happened when you got back to New York?

Well, I stayed in the house for about two weeks, for fear that someone would say the wrong thing and it would bring out bad vibes with me, and then it would be physical combat, you know. So, when I finally decided to come out of the house, I got on the sidewalk, and it felt like an escalator. It felt like the sidewalk was trying to go out from under me, I was that nervous.
